headline: Up Your Arsenal proposals cover the front end, Veldin and Florana
summary: Three pull requests propose more matching C for Up Your Arsenal's PAL v1.00, covering the front-end program, Veldin and Florana. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. None merged, so master gained no commits.
highlights: #10 proposes eight front-end functions and 12 level functions, with near misses kept separately as drafts.
#11 proposes 20 Veldin functions and retains near misses separately. Its author reports that the rebuilt level matches the disc.
#12 proposes 24 Florana functions, 11 near-miss drafts and notes on matching patterns. The drafts do not count as matches.
